clips.title: The story
paras: At the Sepulcher, Ataeric's Staff marks the archmage's defeat. Archmage Ataeric, a senior Dalaran wizard in Silverpine Forest, wielded it to command local ley lines.

Shadow Priest Allister feared Dalaran's growing reach in magic and ordered Ataeric killed. He also demanded the staff. Once Ataeric was slain and the staff recovered, the concentrated ley energies sank back into dormancy. Carrying the staff to the Sepulcher marked a clear victory over Dalaran's ambitions. Yet power still lies latent in the earth, and the Forsaken remain watchful.
